office_does: The prosecuting attorney decides which criminal cases to charge and prosecutes them, and is the county government's lawyer in civil matters.
race_blurb: Uncontested, but the only candidate has resigned: appointed prosecutor Sean P. Lewis (Prefers Republican Party) stepped down for health reasons on Sept. 30, 2026, and his name remains on the ballot. Former prosecutor Gordon Edgar is serving as interim; commissioners plan another interim appointment in early 2027.

candidates.summary: Appointed Douglas County prosecutor in 2025 with 30 years of legal experience; he resigned for health reasons effective Sept. 30, 2026, but remains the only name on the ballot.
highlights: Resigned effective Sept. 30, 2026, citing health reasons; his name stays on the ballot [S3]
Says he cut overspending on criminal case management and reduced a backlog of unprosecuted cases [S1]
Appointed by the county commissioners to finish Gordon Edgar's term [S2]
